notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary interaction service-report failures. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM data elements, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies typed failure reports, exception identity, serial progression, and application-callback suppression without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador ordinary SendInteraction failure boundaries and FederateAmbassador service-report delivery
